rationale: Ground truth has no substantive concerns, so both trivially satisfy recall. Both independently converge on the same two strongest findings (the new test lacks pytestmark so CI's marker-filtered selection silently deselects it, and the sm_110a/cc-11.x gap between the PR's own tcgen05 claim and the ==10 gate), which cross-validates those as real. Y goes further and verifies the CI-deselection claim with an actual local pytest run, and surfaces two additional non-obvious, concretely-fixable defects X misses entirely (warmup_quack_fp8 bypassing quack_enabled(), and warning_once's exception-object cache key defeating dedup), each with a suggested patch and clear blocking/should-fix severity. X's review, while similarly grounded, pads its output with repetitive/near-duplicate 'validated' bullets and a lower-value blast-radius note, diluting signal despite covering the same core ground as Y.
